[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The 1921 census lists Harriett Treson Glasgow, aged 58 years and four months, as wife in George Glasgow’s household at 21 Denmark Road, Willesden, Middlesex, England. The age suggests a birth about 1863.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/63150/records/10429121 Ancestry, 1921 England Census: Harriett Treson Glasgow, RG 15/6466, ED 10, Sch 154, record 63150/10429121].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The census identifies the resident and household. Birth surname and earlier identity remain unresolved.
